name: Better village controls
author: irongete
description: Every colour row -- the Kin, Village and Realm tabs of the Kith & Kin window, and the claim window -- grows a picker beside it carrying every group the server takes, 0 to 254. It shows the group the row is in -- the number, which is all a group past the eight colours has -- and picking one drives the row the way a click on a square would. That includes the claim window's permission row.
